emergency.label: Call 911
emergency.for: If you or someone else is in immediate danger.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.for: Thoughts of suicide, a mental health or substance use crisis, or worry about someone else. You do not have to be suicidal to call.
resources.more: En español, call 988 and press 2. Veterans and service members, call 988 and press 1, or text 838255.
resources.hours: Free and confidential, 24 hours a day

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.for: When typing is easier than talking.
resources.hours: Free and confidential, 24 hours a day, in English and Spanish

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.for: If you are afraid of someone at home, or someone is hurting, threatening, or controlling you.
resources.hours: Free and confidential, 24 hours a day

resources.name: RAINN National Sexual Assault Hotline
resources.for: After sexual assault or abuse, whenever it happened.
resources.hours: Free and confidential, 24 hours a day, in English and Spanish

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.for: Finding treatment for drug or alcohol use or for mental health, for you or someone you love. It gives referrals and information, not crisis counseling; in a crisis, call 988.
resources.hours: Free and confidential, 24 hours a day, in English and Spanish
